Class TransactionConfig

java.lang.Object
com.duck.model.type.TransactionConfig
public class TransactionConfig extends Object
Configuration object used to define the parameters for querying or creating a Transaction. Includes transaction type, date Period, category list, amount Range, and the owning Account.
